candidates_max5.statistical_state_description: Among KEYSTONE live-pass pools (friction>=-5% & p_fatal<=min(0.468,0.27)), entry-time residual state predicts continuation of executable QuoterV2 net>0. Score s = HGB(max_depth=3,max_iter=80,lr=0.05).predict_proba(X)[:,1]; threshold = train quantile 0.50 of s on KEYSTONE live-pass.
